hook: Mark Chen has been at OpenAI since 2018, moving from quantitative trading into leading some of the company's most visible research programs. He co-led the team that built DALL-E, directed the vision work that gave GPT-4 its multimodal capabilities, and oversaw Codex, the model behind GitHub Copilot. In March 2025 OpenAI named him Chief Research Officer, a role focused on integrating research and product development so new capabilities move into deployment faster. He also coaches the USA Computing Olympiad team, a pastime that tracks with his own path through competitive mathematics and computer science at MIT.

standing.standing: Mark Chen is Chief Research Officer at OpenAI, a position he has held since March 24, 2025, and he has been with the company since 2018. In that role he focuses on integrating research and product development so new capabilities move into deployment faster, which places him at the center of how OpenAI turns research into shipped products. His influence rests on research programs he co-led or directed, including DALL-E, the vision work behind GPT-4's image understanding, and Codex, the model underlying GitHub Copilot. OpenAI's own GPT-4 contributions page credits him as Vision team co-lead and Deployment lead, and the o1 contributions page lists him under Leadership and Executive Leadership. He also coaches the USA Computing Olympiad team, a role outside the company that draws on his background in competitive mathematics and computer science at MIT.
